recipe.criteria: Rigid torso and straight legs; fixed palms and toes. Demonstration timing chosen for this asset: 3 seconds down, 1 second bottom hold, 1 second up, 3 seconds top hold. Timing is not prescribed by ACE.
limitations: Top elbows retain approximately 7.8 degrees of flexion; chest does not touch the floor.
Virtual floor support only; sampled geometry is not full mesh collision or human motion certification.
The 3-1-1-3 timing is an illustrative tempo chosen for this clip, not prescribed by the source.
